summary: Grupo Aval Acciones y Valores S.A., a Colombian bank holding company and SEC foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a notice of relevant information dated September 28, 2026. The Company reported payment of interest on its Sixth Issuance of Notes, denominated in Pesos in the Colombian market, as provided under the terms of the applicable offering memorandum. No stake, price per share, implied value, premium, board recommendation, advisor, structural mechanics, or regulatory clock is disclosed. This is a routine debt-service event, mapping to a US Form 8-K interest-payment disclosure, with no special-situation or risk-arb angle to watch.
